description: A sine with separate pitch and amplitude envelopes and a saturated output, built from the 808 and 909 bass drums

params.text: Sets the resting frequency of the sine, 20Hz to 100Hz; the tooltip and the manual say 10Hz to 40Hz
Sets how far the pitch envelope lifts the sine at the start of a hit, up to 500Hz above the resting frequency
Sets how fast that lift falls away, 5ms to 35ms; the tooltip and the manual say the top is 30ms
Sets how fast the hit fades, 5ms to 305ms
Multiplies the output before it clips at 5V, from 1 fully anticlockwise up to 3, 11 or 101 depending on the L | M | H switch
Sets how far SATURATION can go: L multiplies by up to 3, M by up to 11, H by up to 101; the switch's own tooltip reads 2x, 10x and 100x, which is the part added to 1
Fires the kick; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires the sound; the length of the gate makes no difference
Adds to the P. DEPTH knob
Adds to the P. DECAY knob
Adds to the AMP DECAY knob

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
a trigger restarts the sine phase along with both envelopes, so every hit begins with the same rise and there is no click from a part-finished cycle
